one_line: The paper proposes and validates an ISO 50001-based energy management maturity model for Chinese industrial enterprises, empirically tested on three discrete-manufacturing case firms (aluminium-section and bathroom-accessory building-materials makers and a semiconductor component maker), with continuous-flow sectors like steel, fertilizer and pulp & paper only mentioned in passing or references.
